imagery: Nearmap Vert, EPSG:7855, 0.075 m/px, 7759 x 4959 px

human_baseline.note: Measured on the pre-fix pipeline. The site geometries behind these IDs are no longer on disk, so a fresh human review pass is required before this recall figure can be recomputed.

measurements.name: pixel_detector_preset
measurements.comparison: same imagery pair, only the preset differs
measurements.interpretation: The shipped default defers the entire scene as shadow-uncertain and returns nothing.

measurements.name: dino_footprint_input_normalisation
measurements.comparison: same model and imagery, only the input scaling differs
measurements.interpretation: A built-out suburban estate is roughly 20-35% roof, so only the normalised input is physically plausible. Sampled tile coverage: 2.28% raw, 18.92% scaled 0-1, 20.31% ImageNet.

measurements.name: outline_regularisation
measurements.comparison: same candidates, with and without dominant-orientation snapping
measurements.interpretation: Edge-angle error is only meaningful on already-simplified polygons. Raw shapes() output follows the pixel grid, so every edge is axis-aligned and the metric reads near zero by construction.

measurements.name: resolution_ladder
measurements.comparison: same model, imagery downsampled before inference
measurements.interpretation: Refuted the hypothesis that ground sample distance caused the misses. Coverage fell monotonically with coarser imagery, which pointed at preprocessing instead.

measurements.name: fusion_of_fixed_channels
measurements.interpretation: Cross-source agreement rose from 3 to 53 candidates, which is the clearest signal that the channels are now describing the same real objects.

outstanding: No precision/recall for the fixed pipeline. Needs a fresh human review pass over the current candidates, since the labelled site geometries are gone.
The Melbourne CBD West benchmark cannot be re-run locally because that AOI's imagery is not in data/input.
Vision-model review is implemented but unexercised: integrate.api.nvidia.com is blocked on the development network.
